name: Malkhana
what: Hardware and building-material shops sell cement, rod and pipe across shop and godowns, while the owner sees cost, profit and a theft-catching audit that staff cannot.
hard_part: The cost lock is enforced on the server: per-role fields are stripped from every sync, operation and backup response, and a leak test logs in as each staff role and fails on any cost, profit or margin key. Cost is a weighted average landed cost snapshotted on every bill line, so profit is exact per line.
demo_note: one-tap demo roles (owner, manager, counter, godown) with a role switcher; #/points tour
facts: 4 roles, each in a private 24-hour sandbox shop
21 Go tests including a field-leak scan across every API response
Audit flags below-cost sales, voids, discounts, missing memo numbers and transfer shortages
